info.title: API-DocTest-List Fitness Memberships Status-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve the status of fitness memberships. It facilitates access to real-time data regarding active, expired, or pending memberships for fitness centers. Typically utilized by gym management systems or customer service applications, this endpoint enhances customer engagement by providing valuable insights into membership statuses. Developers can integrate this API to streamline membership inquiries and improve user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of memberships for users. It provides insights into whether a member is active, expired, or in any other defined status.
